correctness.rationale: An injective E-pattern with demanded block sizes mu embeds in host class-size capacities lambda iff each sorted mu_i<=lambda_i. Weight of each admissible labeled set partition is r!/(prod mu_i! prod_j multiplicity_j!), yielding b_r, while u_r counts admissible integer partitions. Every ordered k-tuple has one of Stirling(k,r) equality partitions and b_r E-patterns, hence T_k=sum S(k,r)b_r; all qf definable relations are unions of atomic diagrams, count 2^T_k. Because b_n>0, S(k,n)~n^k/n! gives lim T_k^(1/k)=n; first n via triangular inversion. Explicit n4 and n5 partition lists prove minimality of distinct-profile collisions. n5 pair (3,2),(2,1,1,1) both b=(1,2,4,7,10); n4 unlabeled (3,1),(2,1,1) both u=(1,2,2,1). Degenerate equality/universal cases explicitly excluded for first-boundary claim.
